thread.title: Apple shares rise on 3Q jump in average price of iPhones

author: Ryan Nakashima, AP Technology Writer
title: Apple shares rise on 3Q jump in average price of iPhones
text:
Apple: Fiscal 3Q Earnings Snapshot Posted:
CUPERTINO, Calif. (AP) _ Apple Inc. (AAPL) on Tuesday reported fiscal third-quarter net income of $11.52 billion.
The Cupertino, California-based company said it had net income of $2.34 per share.
The results surpassed Wall Street expectations. The average estimate of 10 analysts surveyed by Zacks Investment Research was for earnings of $2.17 per share.
The maker of iPhones, iPads and other products posted revenue of $53.27 billion in the period, also exceeding Street forecasts. Eight analysts surveyed by Zacks expected $52.37 billion. Advertisement
For the current quarter ending in September, Apple said it expects revenue in the range of $60 billion to $62 billion. Analysts surveyed by Zacks had expected revenue of $58.59 billion.
Apple shares have climbed 12 percent since the beginning of the year, while the Standard & Poor's 500 index has climbed slightly more than 5 percent. In the final minutes of trading on Tuesday, shares hit $190.29, a climb of 28 percent in the last 12 months.
